feng_entry_status: FengArithmetic proves Dlog(f*g)=Dlog(f)*g+f*Dlog(g), mu*Lambda=-Dlog(mu), and the exact original fengArithmetic=Dlog(Dlog(mu))+mu*Dlog(Lambda). The weighted divisor formula retains prime powers with cutoff N/r. Regression theorems give feng(p)=0 and feng(p^2)=log(p)^2 for every prime p. FengCoefficientBridge splits original PRZZ coefficients, scaledArithmetic and the literal gcdMainTerm into ordered 00+20+02+22 components, and keeps coefficients at g*n in the generic diagonalization. FengShift proves the unrestricted shifted Feng sum equals L^2 times the second A-derivative of the finite Conrey inner sum plus the explicit log-weighted Mangoldt convolution with translated cutoff/profile. L is nonzero for the derivative identity; no profile endpoint, limit or false factorization at g*n is assumed. The coefficient retains the original log(length)^2 normalization and no 2! division. These are finite identities, not proofs of H20/H02/H22 asymptotics. Remaining duties are the prime-power convolution at g*n, uniform averaged bounds on both reflected bidiscs, endpoint control, and identification of the three kernels.
feng_gn_status: FengAtG.feng_at_mul and fengBlock_decomposition retain the exact original coefficient at g*n as the log-square block plus the prime-power divisor correction coprime to g and an explicit shared-prime correction. No squarefree truncation is imposed, and shared_prime_square proves the shared correction is log(p)^2 at g=n=p. logBlock_derivatives expresses the log-square block as mu(g) times [t^2 C - 2t C' + C''], where t=log(g)/L and C=L times the actual finite coprime Mobius sum. FengLogBounds applies radius-one Cauchy estimates on an enlarged shift ball and the proved endpoint-safe coprime bound: norm(logBlock)<=D E0(g), uniformly for bounded log(g)/L, all u in [0,U], and both reflected bidiscs. FengLogEndpoint proves a generic Euler-square window transfer and smallness of the harmonic average of products of the actual log blocks in the endpoint window; the endpoint width and L threshold are uniform on both bidiscs. Normalization is L/L^2 before theta^-2. These estimates concern only the logarithmic block, not the complete Feng coefficient. The sharedBlock and outsideBlock uniform asymptotics, their endpoints and cross-products, and H20/H02/H22 identification remain open. No new axiom, numerical certificate change, final zero proportion, commit or push.
